class.name: ColorRoleTransform
class.brief_description: Resolves and transforms a semantic color from a [ColorScheme].
class.description: [ColorRoleTransform] preserves the personal Material color-role transformation workflow without replacing Godot's global [enum ColorRole] enum. It resolves [member color_role] from a [ColorScheme], or uses [member static_color] for [constant COLOR_ROLE_STATIC], then applies scaling, inversion, darkening, lightening, interpolation, and optional clamping in that order. A transform can interpolate toward [member lerp_color], a second semantic role, or another [ColorRoleTransform]. Cyclic transform references are rejected while resolving.

method.name: resolve
method.description: Resolves the configured color. [param color_scheme] may be [code]null[/code] only when the base color and interpolation target are both static.

members.member: Clamps the final color components to the [code]0.0[/code] through [code]1.0[/code] range.
Semantic role used as the base color. [constant COLOR_ROLE_STATIC] selects [member static_color].
Component-wise multiplier applied before the other transforms.
Static interpolation target and fallback for [constant COLOR_ROLE_STATIC].
Semantic interpolation target used when [member lerp_color_role_enabled] is [code]true[/code] and [member lerp_transform] is empty.
Uses [member lerp_color_role] instead of [member lerp_color] as the interpolation target.
Optional transformed interpolation target. This takes precedence over [member lerp_color_role].
Interpolation weight from the transformed base color to the configured target.
Amount passed to [method Color.lightened] after darkening.
Base color used when [member color_role] is [constant COLOR_ROLE_STATIC].
